about_the_game:
Build a convenience store on an asteroid. Full immersive VR.
Gather ingredients, put them into machines and craft items your customers will love.
Unlock new areas like the merchant and mushroom biome.

Merchant offers you great machines and helpers to support you in your endevour.
They range from shelves to display your products, to machines like a slushy maker to craft delicious slushys.
Each machine is carefully designed with VR interaction as its main purpose.
Twiddle with knobs, attach gas bottles, smash buttons. Lots of interactive content.

VR is programmed in a way so it is perfectly played while seating.
But of course, you can play this standing as well.
There is also a distance grab, so you don't need to bend down to pick something up if this is not your thing.

You start small by selling stones, but soon you will whirl around the slushy maker and fire up the grill.

Mushroom biome is the first unlockable biome, which offers more items and even a first small critter.
Which of course needs to be made into a recipe and sold to customers.

You can control demand by placing or removing items in shelves for customers to view.
What customers don't see, they won't buy, easy peasy.
Once you run out of items you can just shut down the store, and no new customers approach, so you can focus on getting the shelves stocked up.
